author: nickyeow

english.text: A bad habit, once formed, is difficult to get rid of.

jyutping: jat1 joeng5 sing4 zo2 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3，zau6 hou2 naan4 goi2 faan2 zing3 gaa3 laa3。
text: 一養成咗壞習慣，就好難改返正㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: May I bring my family along?

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 jat1 cai4 lai4 gaa3？
text: 我可唔可以同屋企人一齊嚟㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: This apple tastes sour.

jyutping: ne1 lap1 ping4 gwo2 hou2 syun1。

author: Riko

english.text: You look busy.

jyutping: nei5 hou2 ci5 hou2 mong4 gam3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll be seventeen next year.

jyutping: ngo5 haa6 nin2 zau6 sap6 cat1 seoi3 laa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You'll get a clear picture with this antenna on the roof.

jyutping: baai2 zo2 ne1 tiu4 tin1 sin3 hai2 uk1 deng2 dou6，go3 waa2 min2 zau6 wui5 cing1 di1 gaa3 laa3。
text: 擺咗呢條天線喺屋頂度，個畫面就會清啲㗎喇。

author: fucongcong

english.text: Please.

jyutping: m4 goi1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Give me a call tonight.

jyutping: gam1 maan1 daa2 bei2 ngo5 laa1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I am really tired of living.

jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 zou6 jan4 laa3。

author: kaenif

english.text: Make sure you get rid of your cold. You've got to be ready again next week. We can't do without you.

jyutping: nei5 go3 soeng1 fung1 gei3 zyu6 faai3 di1 hou2 faan1 aa3，nei5 haa5 go3 lai5 baai3 zau6 jau6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 hou2 gaa3 laa1，ngo5 dei6 mou5 zo2 nei5 m4 dak1 gaa3。
text: 你個傷風記住快啲好返呀，你下個禮拜就又要準備好㗎啦，我哋冇咗你唔得㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wrote three letters last night.

jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 se2 zo2 saam1 fung1 seon3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That's what we're looking for.

jyutping: ni1 joeng2 zau6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 wan2 gan2 ge3 je5。
text: 呢樣就係我哋搵緊嘅嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How many Christmas presents did you give this year?

jyutping: nei5 gam1 nin4 sung3 zo2 gei2 do1 fan2 sing3 daan3 lai5 mat6 bei2 jan4 aa3？
text: 你今年送咗幾多份聖誕禮物俾人呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom may not need our help.

jyutping: aa3 Tom mei6 bit1 seoi1 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 bong1 sau2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't want to let that happen.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 ni1 gin6 si6 faat3 sang1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Guess what card this is.

jyutping: gu2 haa2 ne1 zoeng1 hai6 me1 kat1？

author: kaenif

english.text: I think they'll understand.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 wui5 ming4 ge3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you coming or not?

jyutping: nei5 lai4 m4 lai4 ge3 zek1？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: What's the largest airport in the world?

jyutping: sai3 gaai3 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 gei1 coeng4 hai2 bin1 syu2 aa2？
text: 世界最大嘅機場喺邊處啊？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: They say they're going to resign.

jyutping: keoi5 dang2 waa6 jiu3 ci4 zik1 wo3。
